sourceRefs.locator: p. 69, survey of Claudian: poem celebrating Stilicho’s victory at Pollentia in 402.
Extract: first shift of Alaric’s campaigns to Italy in 402.

summary.de: Pollentia lag bei Pollenzo im heutigen Piemont. Im Jahr 402 kämpften Alarichs Verband und Stilichos Truppen in der Gegend.
summary.en: Pollentia stood at Pollenzo in present-day Piedmont. Alaric’s following and Stilicho’s forces fought in the area in 402.
